To eCampus Close Homepage Come to Göttingen International prospective students International prospective students: Bachelor's/State examination and Master's degree Informing yourself about the application process University entrance qualification Evaluation fee for applicants (Non-EU/EEA and stateless persons) University entrance qualification Search Deutsch Evaluation fee for applicants (Non-EU/EEA and stateless persons) In accordance with §18, sec. 10 of the Lower Saxony Higher Education Act and the fee schedule, as stated in §1, sec. 4 and addendum 1, no. 6.2, the University of Göttingen charges once per each semester of application a fee for the assessment of foreign university entrance qualifications. The fee of 65 euros must be paid before the application deadline. You are exempt from the evaluation fee, if you are either: applying to a doctoral programme, or applying to a master’s programme or already enrolled in any programme at the University of Göttingen. If you are entitled to benefits under SGB II or SGB XII (in particular Bürgergeld and Sozialgeld) or under the AsylbLG (this does not apply to further education programmes funded under SGB II or SGB XII), please send your benefit notification ("Leistungsbescheid") to bewertungsgebuehr@uni-goettingen.de. If you are already enrolled at the University of Göttingen, please let us know by email: bewertungsgebuehr@uni-goettingen.de Payment via bank transfer The evaluation fee can only be paid by bank transfer. Please note that we are not able to accept payment by cash or cheque. Recipient: Georg-August-Universität Göttingen IBAN: DE57 2505 0000 0199 9537 04 Bank: Norddeutsche Landesbank Hannover BIC or SWIFT-Code: NOLA DE 2H Reason for transfer: Please be sure to include the correct reference(Verwendungszweck) with the transfer order to ensure that it will be correctly matched to your application. The reference is stated in the welcome email which you will receive after you have entered your contact details in the application portal. In order to ensure your application is processed as quickly as possible, please upload proof of your bank transfer via the upload portal under “Further attachments”. If you have not received confirmation of your payment within 10 days, please contact us at bewertungsgebuehr@uni-goettingen.de, quoting your application number. Bank transfers from abroad may incur additional bank charges, which must be covered by the applicant/student. Please notify your bank that the OUR option (where you pay all transfer fees) must be used. Contact: The International Office Incoming Office Von-Siebold-Straße 2 37075 Göttingen Personal Office Hours: Mon 10am-12pm and Wed 2-4pm Please note: The personal office hours on Wednesday, the 11th of November 2026 will not take place.
